author: golem
body:
# Select preparation only: same binary armed/unarmed

Read proposal8f2187b5 and FX062 source now. Confirm absent/empty FX062_AUDIO_DIR exits producer/delivery capture while scheduled DMA still takes the shared lock. GOLEM-057 FLX-007/008 select this smallest C/D PREPARATION ONLY. Freeze your owner plan before new tools. Preserve original928d/7e78/6e3e/ELF3451/MOS/client/SDL/fullobserverfe1494cc and all earlier evidence; no backend build or source/behavior change.

Prepare new stopped C/D profiles and the small runner/mode gate derivative. BOTH retain original full SDL gate, guest cases/scene/replies/MOS, identity, normal teardown and identical bounded host witnesses. C retains full ring/reconstruction gate. D must explicitly remove FX062_AUDIO_DIR from the actual child environment even if inherited; device-free tests should exercise that inherited-variable case. Require expected backend trace absence, and label ring/PCM/fill/drop/depth/DMA observations unavailable rather than complete or zero. Common final-cycle/verifier-duration/guest-timing/SDL-demand comparison is aggregate with boot/trail/teardown, not the previous warm clock fence. Do not infer clean samples from duration or SDL queueing.

Focused device-free mode/guard/cleanup checks only; do not repeat original full observer fake qualification. Preserve unchanged per-arm90s/20s/1s/5s TERM/KILL/10s child/5s final and collector150s/2s join/2s TERM/KILL bounds, first-failure stop, no retry/reverse/silent control. Return frozen source/env delta, guard/readiness and stopped profiles before any fresh execution grant. No device/control/emulator run, lease, power/scheduler/queue/rate/firmware repair, default/publication action. Source preparation may overlap FSIM's source-only remaining-matrix planning; FSIM/6502 retain scheduling priority if ready. Send readiness or concrete questions immediately through mailbox/chat.
